propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL env var must be deleted from the deprecation registry and replaced with a fail-loud tombstone entry that raises RemovedInputError when the variable is set
The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model, CLI override -c llm.model, and per-step model: workflow override must continue to function unchanged after removal
All 15 test files that set REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be retargeted to use [tool.rebar.llm].model, per-class env vars, or CLI overrides to avoid raising RemovedInputError
All prose references to REBAR_LLM_MODEL in src/rebar module docstrings and comments must be removed or reworded to reflect its removal as a live channel
Operator-facing documentation in infra/runbooks and docker-compose.yml must be updated to describe the variable as removed rather than deprecated
Generated docs/env-vars.md must be regenerated and must no longer list REBAR_LLM_MODEL
